advancement: Author-created85/100 overall and at least15/20 per essential exam domain; remediate any critical feasibility, incentive, funding, proof-quantifier or integrity error before advancement; then transfer and teach-back. No institutional equivalence or empirically calibrated forms/timing.
coverage_policy: Map actual assessed subparts to every chapter outcome across both forms and project; each form should cover all12 at bounded depth when coherent. Explicitly identify deeper reserved scopes, never infer complete coverage from a heading.
originality: New configurations and inference/proof tasks; no mechanical renaming or source exam reproduction. Distinct reassessment structures, no identical methods with only parameter swaps.
review_efficiency: Compact contracts/proofs/records referencing exact inputs, actual source scopes and changed findings. One full blueprint audit, final manuscript/all solutions, bounded author/peer runtime gates, then one coherent integration.
acceptance: No volume acceptance until diagnostic, both exams, project/input/code/output/README/manifest, solutions/rubrics, retention/remediation and indices all accepted; offline and full structural/numerical checks follow.
